cases.title: The question in the wrong script
cases.q: cycle yojana mein cycle kab milegi?
cases.answer: Passage: Unfortunately, there is no direct passage provided in the text to answer this question accurately. However, in general knowledge, a yojana is a traditional Indian unit of distance equivalent to approximately 12 to 15 kilometers (7.5 to 9.3 miles). Since a yojana consists of a series of cycles, a yojana would consist of a series of yojanas, each containing a series of cycles. If we consider a yojana to consist of a series of 12 kilometers, then a series of yojanas would consist of a series of 12 kilometers each, multiplied by the number of yojanas being considered.
cases.truth: In the first week of August 2026

trace.parse: Clean English and Hindi pages. Fine.
trace.chunk: Sentence chunks. Not ideal, but the answer is in one sentence here.
trace.search: Keyword search only: zero results. “cycle kab milegi” in Latin letters shares no word with “साइकिल कब मिलेगी” in Devanagari, or with the English page.
trace.prompt: No passages at all, and a basic prompt that doesn’t say what to do when there’s nothing.
trace.model: Filled the gap from general knowledge: “a yojana is a traditional Indian unit of distance…”.

cases.why: Keyword search can’t match a romanised question to Devanagari text. With nothing retrieved, the model improvised. (A strict prompt would at least have said “I don’t know”.)
cases.fix: Add vector search with a multilingual embedding model and fuse the two (hybrid, module 9).

cases.fixedBy: Hybrid search, same chunks and prompt
